surah.personality_title: Ad-Duha — The Morning Splendor & Divine Consolation in Apparent Silence
surah.personality_summary: Tender, intimate, maternal, intensely consoling. Addressed directly to the Prophet during a painful cessation of revelation: 'Your Lord has neither forsaken you nor hated you.' Reminds him of his orphanhood, wandering, and poverty, commanding tenderness toward orphans and petitioners, and proclamation of divine grace.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Ad-Dhuhaa (The Morning Hours) is the 93th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 11 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and by the night when it grows still

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: your Lord has not forsaken you [Prophet], nor does He hate you

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the future will be better for you than the past

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: your Lord is sure to give you so much that you will be well satisfied

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did He not find you an orphan and shelter you

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And He found you lost and guided [you]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did He not find you lost and guide you

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did He not find you in need and make you self-sufficient

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So do not be harsh with the orphan

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and do not chide the one who asks for help

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: talk about the blessings of your Lord
